title: MBA Class of 1962 Senior Lecturer of Business Administration
bio: Overview US-China relations; boards of directors and comparative corporate governance; leadership; the intersection of business and government, especially in relation to foreign policy/national security.

Since July 2024, he has served as the Faculty Chair of HBS’ Middle East, North Africa & Central Asia Research Center. Dr. Zelleke's current teaching assignments include the 3rd-year seminar in the HBS/Harvard Kennedy School Joint Degree program; the Saudi Arabia Immersive FIELD Course (co-taught with Prof. Tarun Khanna); and the FIELD CAP course.
